subject: Nervous tissue
hook: NERVOUS TISSUE IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK
angle: Nervous tissue is not just neurons; in fact, the most abundant cell type in the human brain is the star-shaped astrocyte, a type of neuroglial cell.
angle_support: Astrocytes: Star-shaped macroglial cells with many processes found in the CNS. They are the most abundant cell type in the brain, and are intrinsic to a healthy CNS.
Neuroglia encompasses the non-neural cells in nervous tissue that provide various crucial supportive functions for neurons.
title: The Hidden Star of Your Brain
description: Think the brain is just neurons? You're missing the most abundant cell type entirely. Discover the role of the astrocyte.
narration: NERVOUS TISSUE IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You picture the brain as a complex web of lonely neurons firing away. It was closer to a dense landscape dominated by something entirely different and silent. While neurons grab the spotlight, they are outnumbered. The most abundant cell type in your brain is actually the star-shaped astrocyte. These crucial macroglial cells provide vital support, maintain balance, and outnumber neurons throughout the central nervous system. The true architects of your mind are likely not neurons.
